## Schema & Contracts
#185 backfilled 53 schema_version violations in omnibase_spi with wire-format bypass comments and fixed pre-commit hook failures. #141 removed the env-prefix mandate from SPI protocol contracts, clarifying that topics are realm-agnostic. #243 removed residual `from __future__ import annotations` directives from 15 src/ protocol modules, surfacing masked annotation bugs. #1372 added canonical Cursor hook models and enums as a peer to the existing claude_code/ module.

## CI & Infrastructure
#336 granted pull-requests: read to the ban-hardcoded-runner-ip caller job, resolving 125 startup failures. #362 upgraded omnibase-core to 0.47.39 in uv.lock and removed the onex_change_control preflight from contract-validation. #3708 re-pinned the repo-evidence caller to receipt-gate commit 4e4f5e0404d364e296c5d37db6aa3ab9e07f8ffa, adding a verifier floor. #1054 removed 5 silent localhost fallbacks in omnibase_core and wired an env-fallback validator as a CI gate. #1006 implemented a path-filtered CI matrix with a docs-only short-circuit using a new file zone classifier. #1745 fixed Contract Compliance to read contracts at the PR's own evidence commit and judge test_passes items in CI Summary. #133 bumped actions/setup-python from 5 to 6. #1196 bumped OmniNode-ai/onex_change_control in the actions group.

## Core & Runtime
#1868 changed GitRepo.read_blobs to use temporary files instead of a stdin pipe, fixing a macOS hang. #1829 implemented OMN-20200 trusted goal admission with OCC goal verification contracts. #1612 added semantic severity for StatusGrid, removing hex defaults in favor of theme-resolved colors. #1365 repinned onex-change-control to an immutable SHA to avoid a circular dependency. #1751 fixed the append-only gate to read companion branch commits individually. #1041 added a model health status contract for delegation routing. #1081 routed run-node through contract dispatch and replaced a KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS fallback with fail-fast access.

## Omnimarket Features
#3740 added lab job check schedule compute and effect nodes for supervisor milestone M4. #3504 isolated the DoD proof database environment and updated tests to expect specific evidence failure messages. #2958 declared ownership for claude_hook_events and claude_agent_spans ahead of vendoring. #3785 added tests and a contract for landing release and retry decisions. #3834 installed omnibase_infra 0.38.71 to carry vendored node migrations. #3648 added a gate refusing new deployment facts in packaged routing configs. #3298 added tests pinning that verdicts for tenant-stamped requests carry that tenant to the writer. #3421 implemented node_create_ticket with a ticket-creation guard. #3646 added merge-sweep reader, lane brief, and lane dispatch nodes. #3620 added nodes to publish judged acceptance verdicts and replay committed runs.

## Testing & Verification
#3368 added tests verifying that metering-summary day rows sum exactly to the all-time row for spend, counterfactual, and savings.
